content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rajkot Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AIIMS/RAJKOT/GHAI/EM/2026/74 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AIIMS Rajkot notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS/BDS degree from a recognised institution. Minimum three years of experience in Public Health / Government Health Programmes& its TPA. Experience: Minimum three years of experience in Public Health / Government Health Programmes& its TPA Age limit: Maximum 32 years (as on Last date of Application) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC As per Central Govt Rules Other conditions: Qualification and experience should be in relevant discipline/field from an institution/organization recognized by relevant authority May have to work in shifts/night duty as and when required May have to go on field visits and travel outstation for any need under the project Desirable: Prior experience in Community based study PhD in Biostatistics or Public Health Postgraduate degree after MBBS/BDS Prior experience in the field of Public Health Ability to independently design and execute research studies and undertake policy-oriented work

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Incomplete/unsigned applications, applications not in prescribed format or without supporting documents are summarily rejected Applications received after 3rd Dec 2026, 5:00 PM are summarily rejected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial 1 year, extendable based on performance Purely temporary and contractual; no right to claim regular appointment Services may be terminated for unsatisfactory performance with 1 month notice; candidate may leave with 1 month notice No provident fund, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim etc. Willingness/acceptance certificate and contractual agreement required at appointment

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Rajkot Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications by the selection committee Written test (only if eligible candidates are more than 30) Interview Applications scrutinized by the selection committee Recruitment through interview Written test may be conducted only if eligible candidates are more than 30, to shortlist for interview Original documents required at the interview Selection based purely on merit

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Date of Birth proof Educational qualification certificates (10th/12th/graduate/PG degree/diploma as applicable) and mark sheets PhD certificate and Registration certificate (if applicable) Experience certificates and research publications (if applicable) NOC Certificate (from present employer)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill the online application form through the Google form https://forms.gle/4FBpzmX2i7TJBpy37. Attach scanned copies of self-attested certificates listed in the notice with the application. Submit by 3rd Dec 2026, 5:00 PM. Candidates employed in Central/State Govt., UTs, Statutory Bodies or Research Organizations send applications with NOC through proper channel; an advance copy may be sent by the last date. Bring the physical copy of the form and all documents with photocopies and originals for document verification.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/written test No request for change of Date of Interview shall be entertained No candidate will be allowed to enter after the scheduled date and time Any Addendum/Corrigendum will be issued on the Institutional website only For queries contact [email protected]

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026?

faq.answer: Incomplete/unsigned applications, applications not in prescribed format or without supporting documents are summarily rejected. Applications received after 3rd Dec 2026, 5:00 PM are summarily rejected.
